text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One evening, as we're walking through
the
shopping district...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Look over there, Trainer! I think
something's
going on!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Look at this lovely couple! Why don't
you two
test your love before heading
home from your
date?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eee! ☆ Let's do it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: C'mon, it looks fun! Besides...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Our love is totally gonna snag us the
grand-prize!
Don't you think so? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't see what love and luck have to
do with
each other, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun is overflowing with
enthusiasm,
so we finish our shopping
and then try our hand at
the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! We've only got one raffle ticket,
so this is
our only shot!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... I really, really hope we can get
the
grand-prize!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Praying for good luck, we grasp the
tumbler's
handle together and turn...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: We did it! Mission complete!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! Now then, let's take off... to the
hot
spring! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So what? Who even cares?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we were to leave right now, our
luggage
wouldn't be the only important
thing we'd need to
prepare.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We can't go without adjusting the race
and
training schedules beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: For my sake?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You see, I've already decided on my
goal for this
year. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
This is the year I come out on top... I'll
beat Brian
even if she runs with all she's
got!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All righty then! We'll go once I've
achieved my
goal!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You will come with me, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, yay! No backing out now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
We'll do tooons of relaxing and have
tooons of
fun too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We excitedly think about the day we'll
finally be
able to use the hot spring
coupon.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoa! We got first-prize! Yay!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Buuut it's not the hot spring coupon!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but... I wanted to go on a
lovey-dovey trip
with you...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Rrrgh... There's no way I can capture
your heart
with a hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Are you saying I can?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Then here, I'll give you the
hamburger
steak!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. Well? Do you like me more
now?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Woo-hoo!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You're both so precious! Here, I'll
throw in
another hamburger steak. You
two have fun, now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Thank you, mister!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, he said we're precious! That's like
saying
we're totally in love! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later at night, Mayano Top Gun and I
enjoy our
deluxe carrot hamburger
steaks together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh?! A bushel of carrots?!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
That's right! You get to take home all
the carrots
in that basket over there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The raffle clerk points to a large basket
stuffed
full of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...I dunno if I can eat them all.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Really?! Then you and I...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh! I just got an idea!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Is it okay if we keep these carrots at
your place?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm sharing a room with Teio, I
don't think I
have the space. Pleeease?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yahoo!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Okay then, I'll come by tomorrow and
make a ton
of carrot dishes for you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You'll totally fall in love with me
once you
try my home cooking! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Mayano Top Gun begins
invading my
place a lot more
frequently...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the

third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh?! No way!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mister, are you sure we didn't get the

grand-prize? Like, super sure?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: I'm positive you got the third-prize.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nooo! But my hot spring trip with
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And it's just one carrot...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You can't get me out of your
mind, can
you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd look at a carrot and
immediately
notice it's the same color as
my hair!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun bounces back with a
smile.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I totally thought we'd win! C'mon!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
How can we lose when we love each
other so
much? It doesn't make sense,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we return to campus, I try to comfort
Mayano
Top Gun by explaining again
that love and luck
have nothing to do
with each other.
